name: knock
description: Knock on a door in a given direction. Sound reaches only the adjacent room on the same floor; never propagates outdoors.

knock.note: KNOWN GAP: directional door-gated verb (knock <dir>); resolves an exit door via exitTargets. The door examine set is a fixed hardcoded list that does not include knock, and there is no per-object tag anchor. Same directional class as shove/drag.
